Detailed-tier link coverage before: view_bill 34%, pay_bill 51%, autopay_setup 26%, autopay_cancel 34%, statements_history 13%, paperless 3%, payment_assistance 49% (61 detailed). After: view_bill 39%, pay_bill 61%, autopay_setup 39%, autopay_cancel 47%, statements_history 20%, paperless 5%, payment_assistance 47% (64 detailed; One Call Alert, Galaxy Medical Alert and Diet Direct upgraded from roster). Method: web search was unavailable (session budget exhausted), so the pass used direct fetches only: each brand's sitemap/robots was crawled for billing, terms, return and FAQ pages; terms of service were mined for billing cycle, card-on-file/auto-renew, cancel-and-return-equipment rules (the medical-alert autopay_cancel equivalent) and statement availability; Zendesk help-center APIs were read for LogicMark and Aloe Care; JS-only pages (Alert1, MedicalAlert.org) were read from bundles or with a page renderer. Home-care franchise systems: full sitemaps were crawled for Home Instead (607 offices, 51k URLs), Comfort Keepers (456 offices), Visiting Angels (20k URLs), Senior Helpers (367), Home Helpers (333), Amada (144), SYNERGY, ComForCare, Homewatch, Interim, FirstLight and Always Best Care, and 400 sampled office homepages were scanned for pay/portal links. Findings: no franchise system has a national client bill-pay portal; the local office's scheduling system provides it. WellSky Personal Care (ClearCare) Family Room was confirmed at Home Instead, Comfort Keepers, Visiting Angels and Home Helpers offices; WellSky documents bill pay/split in Family Room. AxisCare's Client + Family Portal (view/pay invoices, autopay, billing history) was seen at Visiting Angels offices. Comfort Keepers offices are moving to Viv Technologies apps that show financial statements. One Senior Helpers office uses Vanco online bill pay. Amada and Nurse Next Door publish LTC-insurance direct billing (assignment of benefits). Still missing: rightathome.net, griswoldcare.com, lifefone.com and brightstarcare.com subpages block automated fetches (BrightStar and Griswold FAQs were read with a page renderer; Right at Home and LifeFone were not); Life Alert, GetSafe, ResponseNow, LifeProtect 24/7, Rescue Alert and Electronic Caregiver publish no billing docs (phone only); paperless billing is documented only by Lifeline, Guardian Medical Monitoring and Enhabit; no named 'CareInMotion Pay' product was found on any franchise or vendor site; per-office portals for the ~5,000 local franchise offices are not enumerated (one example office per brand is recorded); no new brands were added because none could be confirmed without search. The percentages dip slightly because the new detailed records have few portal links. Maxim got its Netsmart patient portal and paperless (Stripe e-invoices). LifeStation's invoice-lookup page was reused for statements. Processor and platform notes: Addus uses PatientNotebook by Waystar; Homewatch offices bill in AlayaCare Care+ (franchise help center shows card surcharges and VA/LTC payer billing). WellSky sandbox or test instances exist for FirstLight HQ and Senior Helpers, and office Family Rooms for Home Helpers (Wilmington) and an Interim office; these are recorded in notes only. Interim's InstaMed 'Patient Portal' (id=INTERIMHC) is not linked from interimhealthcare.com, so it is noted but not used. senior_programs was filled for 10 records (Connect America, QMedic, InnovAge, Addus, BAYADA, MKMeals, UnaliWear, AccentCare, Enhabit, Top Chef). (3) Upgraded: Electronic Caregiver to detailed. Its service agreement gives a 1-year auto-renewing term, a 3-business-day right to cancel and RMA equipment return; phone (833) 324-5433. (4) Added: Trinity Health PACE (detailed; 15 programs, 25 centers, 12 states, 3,000+ participants) and Arosa (roster; company-owned care-managed home care in 7 states). (5) Removed: none. HandsFree Health is still unverified roster: third-party reviews say WellBe is in legacy support and no longer sold direct, and all its hosts are still down. (6) Checked and not added: FastHelp (one-time $299 device with no monthly bill, so not a recurring biller) and Apple Watch (not a biller). (7) Not found: no BrightStar client pay portal (its login sites are franchise/partner tools); doxo listings for Amedisys, Aveanna, FirstLight and BrightStar are third-party, not official; no Life Alert official cancel/contract page (website terms only). (8) Rosters: rosters/ still has no in-scope dataset for PERS, private-duty home care or meal delivery, so completeness was checked against 2026 medical-alert review lists (MedicalAlertBuyersGuide, SeniorList, NCOA) and franchise lists. After pass 4 the main file has 103 entries (73 detailed).
